title: Replace duplicated inline curriculumTracks lookups with the existing TrackDao.getTrackByProfileAndCurriculum
why: Both screens re-implement, inline, the exact (profileId, curriculumId) -> CurriculumTrack? query that TrackDao.getTrackByProfileAndCurriculum already provides -- same where-clause shape, same ..limit(1)).getSingleOrNull(). The DAO method's doc comment records a non-obvious business rule (tutored-mirror local/remote id resolution) that a maintainer fixing that DAO method has no way of knowing also needs re-applying at these 2 inline copies; they will silently drift the next time this query's semantics change.
recommendation: Call ref.read(userDatabaseProvider).trackDao.getTrackByProfileAndCurriculum(profileId, curriculumId.storageKey) at both sites instead of the inline Drift query.
acceptance_criteria: Both call sites use TrackDao.getTrackByProfileAndCurriculum; a grep-based check for `db.select(db.curriculumTracks)` outside core/database/ can catch new inline copies.

corrections: curriculum_settings_screen.dart quote 'await (db.select(db.curriculumTracks)' is at line 157, not 156 as cited.
